description: This file defines an Android Activity 'FragmentStack' that manages a stack of fragments, allowing adding and removing fragments dynamically, with an inner class 'CountingFragment' that displays its number.

classes.name: FragmentStack
classes.description: Main activity managing a stack of fragments with buttons to add or remove fragments.

classes.name: CountingFragment
classes.description: Inner static class representing a fragment that displays its number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and adds the initial fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current stack level state.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Creates and adds a new CountingFragment to the activity, pushing it onto the back stack.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new CountingFragment with a specified number argument.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment's number argument during creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment's UI, displaying its number.
